description: May 29 birthday meaning: Gemini decan 1, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 29 birthday falls in Gemini, in the first decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Gemini is mutable and air.

sections.heading: Personality of a May 29 birthday
paragraphs: A master number appears again on May 29th: 11, the intuitive messenger, kept intact rather than reduced to 2. Seven degrees into Gemini, the Sun's Mercury-ruled decan supplies words for those hunches. The blend is often described as inspired communication, the writer, broadcaster or teacher who seems to sense what an audience needs to hear before anyone asks.

By noon UTC on May 29, the Sun has normally reached roughly 7° of Gemini. That places the date in the Gemini decan that astrologers give to Mercury, the first of three. Doubled Mercury makes the first ten degrees of Gemini, roughly May 21 to May 31, the most quicksilver part of an already lively sign. Curiosity is the engine here: questions, conversations, books opened at the middle, two projects running at once. Traditional descriptions stress wit, verbal agility and a talent for translating between people who would not otherwise understand each other. The same speed can make boredom arrive early and commitments feel like cages. For anyone born in this decan, depth often comes not from slowing down overall but from choosing one or two threads to follow all the way through.

sections.heading: Numerology of the May 29 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 29th, your compound is 2 + 9 = 11, and because 11 is a master number it is kept as 11 rather than reduced to 2. The 2 brings sensitivity, the 9 brings compassion and breadth, and together they create one of the most intuitive birthday numbers. People born on the 29th are often described as emotionally perceptive, idealistic and capable of inspiring others. Their feelings can run high, with marked highs and lows. As a secondary number, the 29 tends to reward creative and caring outlets for that intensity, and rest between them.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same May 29 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: May 29 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 29 is the 149th day of the year (150th in a leap year). In most years Cancer season is under way by June 22, 24 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a May 29 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. May 29 is also the birthday of John F. Kennedy (1917), G. K. Chesterton (1874) and Peter Higgs (1929).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 29?
faq.answer: May 29 is Gemini in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Gemini, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 29?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 29 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 2 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 29th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 29?
faq.answer: By May 29 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 29?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a May 29 birthday are John F. Kennedy (1917), G. K. Chesterton (1874) and Peter Higgs (1929). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
